---
description: "Create a prioritized and dependency-ordered implementation plan from approved design"
name: "SDLC 4 — Implementation Plan"
agent: "Planning Agent"
argument-hint: "Approved architecture and design review"
model: "Claude Sonnet 4.5 (copilot)"
---

Follow [the planning skill](../skills/planning/SKILL.md). Read approved requirements, architecture, design review, and repository conventions.

Create or update `impl-plan.md` with small verifiable tasks ordered by priority. Record real prerequisites separately, expected tests and completion evidence, and explicit blocked tasks with reasons. Include documentation and review/verification work.

Do not implement tasks. Summarize the plan and ask the user to approve it.
